description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'AbstractJsonParsableRegistry' that implements the 'JsonParsableRegistry' interface. It manages a registry of JSON parsing strategies for different types, providing methods to parse JSON strings or objects into typed instances using specified strategies. It includes mechanisms for handling errors robustly, such as wrapping exceptions and resolving the type of JSON objects to determine the appropriate parser.

classes.name: AbstractJsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides a registry for JSON parsing strategies, allowing registration of multiple parse strategies based on type identifiers and providing robust parsing with error handling.

methods.name: AbstractJsonParsableRegistry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parse strategies map, ensuring it is non-null and unmodifiable.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of registered JSON types (keys of parse strategies).

methods.name: parse (String, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an object of type T, with error handling.

methods.name: parse (JsonObject, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject into an object of type T, with error handling.

methods.name: fromJson (String, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Helper method that converts a JSON string into a JsonObject for further processing.

methods.name: fromJson (JsonObject, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Resolves the JSON 'type' and dispatches to the appropriate parse strategy; throws detailed exceptions if parsing fails or type is unrecognized.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to extract the 'type' identifier from a JsonObject.
